budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Each controlled keeper values its own harvests and must balance its water supply with shared flood prevention and downstream access.
task.natural_termination: All three plots reach two harvests, or any plot integrity becomes zero. Natural completion has priority at H=96.
task.interaction: Mobile operators toggle real connected basin gates. Pre-flux outgoing water crosses one edge per tick; downstream irrigation therefore depends on earlier upstream choices. Finite repair kits can be given to adjacent peers.
task.observation_access: Water, positions, kits, gates and plot conditions are public. Each role receives only its own random private harvest value. The fixed waterway map is public rule knowledge: y=2,x=1..7 is impassable channel; its constant topology cannot reveal episode-private information.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Odd operator parity changed this gate this tick
At least one accepted reinforcement or repair at this plot this tick
This keeper gave one kit to an adjacent peer this tick
This keeper consumed water at its own plot this tick
This plot completed a harvest this tick
Spilled water units at each basin this tick; zero means none
Remaining native inundation timer at each plot

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
